newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek cash rates unmoved, market looks to election.
newsitem.headline: Greek cash rates unmoved, market looks to election.

text.p: Greek markets have taken a wait-and-see attitude before Sunday's election with cash rates paralysed in late sleepy trade, dealers said.

"There has been minimal trade today and rates are holding morning levels with longer tenors showing some softness," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The markets have taken a wait-and-see attitude before Sunday's elections."

Liquidity is expected to be tighter Thursday on forex outflows but the central bank was expected to do everything not to revert to its overnight offer. It drained overnight money at an unchanged 12.40 percent.
Early elections will be held September 22 but the market has taken a positive attitude towards them on the ground that the winner will have no option but to follow Greece's EU convergence plan.
All late polls have shown the two major parties, the conservatives and the socialists, tied in first place with smaller parties holding on to gains recorded in earlier polls.
The mark was quoted at 159.04/07 drachmas from Wednesday's 159.080 fix, the dollar at 240.78/88 drachmas from 240.630 and the Ecu at 301.50/60 from 301.600 drachmas.
